Class MockCalendarView

  • java.lang.Object
    • MockCalendarView
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    ICalendarView
    public class MockCalendarView
extends java.lang.Object
implements ICalendarView
    A mock implementation of the ICalendarView interface used for testing purposes. This class simulates the behavior of the ICalendarView by providing mock implementations of the methods responsible for displaying calendar-related data to the user.

      • outputResponse

        public void outputResponse​(java.lang.String data)
        Description copied from interface: ICalendarView
        Outputs the given data to the specified output medium. This method appends the data to the Appendable output stream. If an IOException occurs, it is ignored and no further action is taken.
        Specified by:
        outputResponse in interface ICalendarView
        Parameters:
        data - the data to be output to the user.

      • addFeatures

        public void addFeatures​(Features features)
        Description copied from interface: ICalendarView
        Registers a Features implementation with the view to enable interaction between the view and the controller.

        This allows the view to call back into the controller in response to user actions (e.g., button clicks, menu selections).

        Specified by:
        addFeatures in interface ICalendarView
        Parameters:
        features - the set of controller callbacks the view can invoke
